title: Tally configuration
description: Settings for the OpenCode Tally plugin. Every key is optional; anything you leave out uses the built-in default. Despite the .json name, comments and trailing commas are allowed (JSONC).

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Editors use it to validate and autocomplete this file. Safe to leave as-is.

enableContextBreakdown.description: Include the context breakdown by source (system, instructions, user, tool output, assistant). Requires an OpenCode restart.

enableToolSchemaEstimation.description: Include the estimate of how large the tool definitions are. Requires an OpenCode restart.

enableCacheEfficiency.description: Include the cache hit rate and savings lines. A cache hit is text the provider reused from an earlier request. Requires an OpenCode restart.

enableSubagentAnalysis.description: Include child sessions (subagents) in the report. Requires an OpenCode restart.

enableDetailedSubagentCostBreakdown.description: Expand each subagent into token and estimated cost buckets. Off by default to keep reports short. Requires an OpenCode restart.

enableSkillAnalysis.description: Include the available and loaded skills shown in the report. Requires an OpenCode restart.

sidebar.description: Controls the Tally sidebar block. Changes take effect at the next refresh; no restart needed.

quota.description: Controls subscription quota collection and which providers are read. Changes take effect at the next refresh; no restart needed.

sidebarSection.description: A sidebar section id: subscription quota, context breakdown, recorded usage, or context window.

enabled.description: Show or hide the whole Tally sidebar block.

refreshSeconds.description: How often the sidebar refreshes, in seconds. Must be a whole number of at least 15.

sections.description: Which sections to show, and in what order. Valid values are quota, context, recorded, and contextWindow. If none are valid, the four defaults come back.

showBars.description: Show the small bar next to each number.

showPercentages.description: Show the percentage next to each number.

showWarnings.description: Show the '! N warnings' line when the report has warnings.

showUpdated.description: Show the 'Updated <time>' line at the bottom.

enabled.description: Turn subscription quota collection on or off.

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often quota numbers are fetched, in seconds. Must be a whole number of at least 15.

requestTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for one provider to answer, in milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). Must be at least 1000.

showErrors.description: Show provider error and diagnostic messages. Turn off to hide them.

providers.description: Which subscriptions to read. Empty by default, so no quota appears until you enable a provider here.
Provider entries keyed by provider ID. Remove an entry, or set its 'enabled' to false, to stop reading that provider.

providerConfig.description: Settings for one subscription provider. Most credentials are picked up from OpenCode automatically; only override them if yours needs it.

enabled.description: Turn this provider on. Disabled providers are not fetched and do not appear in the quota list.

label.description: A name of your choosing to show for this provider. Defaults to the provider's own label.

showSidebarBar.description: Show a small bar next to this provider's quota in the sidebar.

sidebarWindow.description: Which quota window to show in the sidebar. 'all' shows every window the provider reports.

showFooterBar.description: Accepted from pasted usage-limits configs, but not rendered by Tally. Safe to leave out.

footerWindow.description: Accepted from pasted usage-limits configs, but not rendered by Tally. 'auto' lets the provider pick its own window.

apiKey.description: API key for the provider. Can be an environment reference such as '{env:MY_KEY}'. Only needed when OpenCode credentials are not picked up.

authPath.description: Path to an auth file or auth record to read credentials from.

baseUrl.description: Override the provider's API origin. A custom origin requires an explicit apiKey or authPath.

authorizationScheme.description: How to send the API key in the Authorization header: as the raw value or as a Bearer token.

region.description: Alibaba Cloud only: which region's account to read. Credentials are not interchangeable across regions.
